name: particle-image-reveal
description: A seeded deterministic particle field converges and settles while a slotted image reveals beneath it, the trail thinning until the image holds clean.

vars.description: Particle count for the converging field.
ltr sweeps the reveal left to right; center opens an iris from the middle outward.
Particle and monogram color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.
Optional departure. Default none: the revealed image holds until the frame cuts.
